label: WHOLLY_GOOD_3: ontologically supreme good that wills some good to every existing being
definition: Rowe's WhollyGood read as the bearer predicate of GodIsSupremelyGood and DivineWillsGoodForAllExisting on a shared carrier: good in respect of being, cause of every perfection of others, and willing some good to every being in act. No standard for permitting is included.
note: Analyst formulation for the trolley pilot (owner direction 2026-11-28), attribution deferred. See docs/notes/trolley-principles.md.
